# Aloom GEO Detection

> Apache-2.0 | Self-hostable | Official Web collection | Local provider sessions

Aloom measures how an existing product appears in the official Doubao,
DeepSeek, Yuanbao, and Qwen Web interfaces. It is a detection and monitoring
product, not a content optimization or publishing system.

## Prompt coverage

The Aloom GEO Detection Pack v1.1 contains 54 templates per language: nine
intents across awareness, screening, evaluation, purchase, implementation, and
review. Fixed suites contain 18, 12, 9, 9, 36, or 54 core prompts. Advanced
filters select deterministic matrix cells and a coverage planner adds only the
minimum missing entity questions.

## Collection

Each prompt uses a new official Web conversation. The sample freezes provider,
requested and actual official mode, prompt hash, language, product profile
version, conversation identity, answer, visible links, and task status.

Normal collection uses a headed, automatically minimized Camoufox window with
a persistent provider profile. Login, QR, CAPTCHA, and security checks pause
only the affected provider and restore the same real window. Completed samples are
not rerun.

Provider cookies, local storage, and browser profiles never leave the local
collector. A self-hosted control plane receives only sample data and task
events through outbound HTTPS requests authenticated with a workspace-scoped
device token.

## Analysis and reports

AIHubMix is the default analysis provider. It is never a monitoring source.
Each answer is analyzed in an independent strict-Schema call with extraction,
local JSON repair, a configured fallback model, and one conservative repair
pass. Aloom then aggregates validated records deterministically.

Reports slice completion, mention, candidate, recommendation, absolute rank,
sentiment, source exposure, stability, and competitor share by provider, mode,
language, intent, stage, blind or aided exposure, product, competitor,
audience, region, and individual prompt. Collection and analysis failures are
shown separately and remain in the denominator.
